caption: the lone 6 leaves and bumps the 4 up out of row 2, which bumps the 2 out of row 1
the 4 ends row 2 and takes the place of the 2 above it
row 1 ends in a corner, so nothing bumps up
the 1 drops out of row 1, so the result holds 2 and 3 only
the 4 bumps the 3, which bumps the 1
deleting the only cell leaves the empty tableau
a semistandard tableau: the 2 takes the place of the last 1
combinatorica.note: Combinatorica swaps with the last entry no larger than the one moving up, so an equal entry is chosen and nothing moves; reverse bumping takes the largest entry strictly smaller, as here, and Combinatorica agrees on every tableau of distinct entries.
